name: Gradaly v5.0.1
title: Gradaly v5.0.1
notes:
### 🚀 Gradaly v5.0.1 — Smooth PDF Viewer Scrolling & Layout Stability
- **Fixed PDF Viewer Rapid Scroll Oscillation & CPU Spike**: Eliminated an asynchronous page state echo loop and redundant PDF canvas re-renders when scrolling rapidly up and down through multi-page student copies in the Grading and Review tabs.
- **Stabilized Grading Right-Panel Page Indicator**: Fixed the height of the page mismatch indicator banner in the Grading tab so that crossing page boundaries while scrolling never shifts the rubric criteria or feedback editors below it.
